newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Kremlin outlines Yeltsin schedule for coming week.
newsitem.headline: Kremlin outlines Yeltsin schedule for coming week.

text.p: President Boris Yeltsin has a week of foreign policy talks and meetings lined up with officials in Russia and abroad, ranging from Middle East peace efforts to domestic economic matters, Itar-Tass news agency quoted the presidential press office as saying on Tuesday.

It said Yeltsin would meet visiting Lebanon Prime Minister Rafik al-Hariri in Moscow on Tuesday for talks aimed at boosing Moscow's role in the Middle East peace settlement and at promoting stagnant bilateral trade.
The Russian president will then meet Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin to discuss urgent steps to improve the economic situation, badly affected by wage arrears and tax evasion.

Yeltsin will also meet Gennady Seleznyov, the head of the communist-dominated State Duma lower house of parliament as well as Ivan Rybkin, the secretary of his top consultative board, the Security Council.
On Wednesday Yeltsin is due to meet 10 regional leaders and new First Deputy Prime Minister Boris Nemtsov.
On Friday Yeltsin will hold talks with the visiting head of Iranian parliament Ali Akbar Nateq-Nouri and meet the head of the Russian Space Agency, Yuri Koptev.
The press service said Yeltsin would give an interview to the German weekly magazine Stern before his meeting with Chancellor Helmut Kohl in the German spa resort of Baden-Baden from April 16 to18.
